// divguard:path ai/anthropic.go

package ai

import "errors"

type StopReason string

const (
	StopReasonStop  StopReason = "stop"
	StopReasonError StopReason = "error"
)

// mapAnthStopReason fails on a reason it does not know, as upstream throws.
func mapAnthStopReason(reason string) (StopReason, error) {
	switch reason {
	case "end_turn":
		return StopReasonStop, nil
	default:
		return StopReasonError, errors.New("Unhandled stop reason: " + reason)
	}
}

type builder struct{}

func (b *builder) fail(error) {}

func finish(b *builder, reason StopReason, data string) {
	if reason == "" {
		b.fail(errors.New("Anthropic stream ended without a stop reason"))
		return
	}
	if data == "[DONE]" {
		b.fail(errors.New("stream ended before a terminal response event"))
	}
}

// fauxReason defaults exactly as upstream's faux provider does.
func fauxReason(reason StopReason) StopReason {
	// upstream: ai/src/providers/faux.ts:stopReason
	if reason == "" {
		reason = StopReasonStop
	}
	return reason
}
